messages.content: What was the full name king of England in 1800?

function.name: monarch_getMonarchOfYear
function.description: Retrieve the monarch of a specific location during a specified year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location (e.g., country) whose monarch needs to be found.

year.description: The year to search the monarch.

fullName.description: If true, returns the full name and title of the monarch.

message.reasoning:
The user asks "What was the full name king of England in 1800?" They want the full name of the King of England in 1800.

We need to retrieve the monarch of England in 1800. We can use the tool `monarch_getMonarchOfYear` with location="England" or maybe "United Kingdom"? But historically, in 1800, there was no United Kingdom yet; it became UK in 1707 as Great Britain, then later united with Ireland in 1801 forming the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. In 1800, the monarchy would have been George III. His full name: George William Frederick Ernest Augustus. He reigned from 1760 until his death in 1820. So answer: George William Frederick Ernest Augustus, King of Great Britain and Ireland (though at that time he was King of Great Britain). Actually, in 1800, before the union with Ireland, he was King of Great Britain. After the Act of Union 1800 came into effect on January 1, 1801, making him King of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland. But question says "king of England". Historically, after Acts of Union 1707, England ceased to exist separately; but we might still refer to him as King of England. For simplicity, answer: George William Frederick Ernest Augustus.

But let's confirm via the tool. We'll call the function.
